children: Tonix Pharmaceuticals received a Paragraph IV ANDA notice from Dr. Reddy’s for a generic version of TONMYA sublingual tablets, 2.8 mg.
Dr. Reddy’s filed an ANDA with a Paragraph IV certification challenging four TONMYA patents listed in the FDA Orange Book.
Filing triggers a 45-day window for Tonix to sue; timely suit would stay FDA approval up to 30 months or until court resolution.
Tonix intends to vigorously enforce its IP rights but cannot predict litigation outcome or timing of potential generic entry.
